_about: A squad's paint (Livery, docs/tank3d.md «Окраска»): a colour and a pattern, kept as one id, "olive" or "olive/woodland". A colour is the army green taken to its base, or with a pattern its four colours light to dark, the ground first. Its name is the key paint.<id>, a pattern's camo.<id>; a pattern's mask is assets/Images/Camo/<id>.png (godot/tools/camo_masks.py). tile: a pattern's tile in hull lengths. Palettes after the jeep game's (jackal_port/ratel, Level3DBtr.PAINTS); brown is the old side_tone.
